architectural_fidelity.reason: Recognizably the same room with preserved white walls, textured ceiling, ceiling fan location, two windows in correct positions, and same camera angle and viewpoint.

furniture_removal.reason: All original furniture completely removed with no ghost outlines, remnants of the blue bedding, nightstand, or Persian rug visible.

style_commitment.reason: Strong Japandi execution with natural wood flooring, neutral tonal palette, minimalist aesthetic, organic ceramic vessels, natural branch in vase, and clean-lined furniture demonstrating clear style conviction.

editorial_density.reason: Has layered textiles on bed (3+ pillows, throw), decorative floor vases, small side table, and foreground coffee table with vase, but lacks wall art, reading lamp, and additional styling details that would achieve full Architectural Digest density.

photorealism.reason: Excellent natural lighting with realistic blind shadows, coherent material textures on wood floor and linens, proper depth of field, and authentic soft shadows without CGI feel.

designer_preference_reason: Cova delivers authentic Japandi style with superior photorealism and natural material palette versus Collov's generic contemporary staging that lacks stylistic conviction.
what_cova_does_better: Authentic Japandi style commitment with natural materials and minimalist restraint
Superior photorealism with natural lighting and realistic material rendering
Preserved original architectural character including tile-to-wood floor transition
Organic, curated feel versus formulaic staging
what_collov_does_better: Higher editorial density with wall art, dimensional lettering, and multiple lighting sources
More layered styling with area rugs, reading chair, floor lamp, and nightstand accessories
Fuller surface vignettes on all horizontal planes
